values: How to fill the hierarchical plan
The structure is easy to enter in Excel and will become an expandable hierarchy after import.
A colored section heading such as Requirements or Testing. It does not need an owner.
A large delivery group under a Phase. Parent No. must be the Phase Task No.
A deliverable under a Main Task. Parent No. must be the Main Task No.
A smaller action under a Task. Parent No. must be the Task No.
Use IDs already listed in LeanControl People Master. Separate multiple assignees with semicolons.
Phase rows must have Level = Phase and no Parent No.
Every Main Task / Task / Subtask must have a Parent No. that exists above it.
Status Done requires Progress = 100. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD.
WBS Code groups the work items. Use one WBS Code for each Phase unless you need a further split.
Yellow project information cells and green rows are examples. Replace them before upload.
